restatement.description: The task, restated in the model's own words. Grading input, not prose.

sites.description: Where the change goes. At least one; an empty brief is not a brief.

risks.description: What could go wrong. May be empty; may not be absent.

approach.description: How the change should be made, in prose. The Change phase reads this.

path.description:
Workspace-relative path. A string here; a `RepoPath` only after the
recorder has checked it against the tree (see `checked::Site`).

first_line.description: Optional line span. `null` means "the whole file", not "line 0".

why.description: Why this site is in the brief.
